<function name="RenderScreen" parent="WEAPON" type="hook">
	<description>
Called every frame just before <page>GM:RenderScene</page>.

Used by the Tool Gun to render view model screens (<page>TOOL:DrawToolScreen</page>).


<note>Materials rendered in this hook require $ignorez parameter to draw properly.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
